findings.message: The 'stored text reaches the reveal builder' chain is covered only in pieces. Reveal.test.tsx asserts the params carry no justification and that those params resolve to 'stored text' through the real resolveRevealInputs. shutter.builder.test.ts asserts justification is args[4]. But the glue in web/src/hooks/useRevealVote.ts:48-50 (resolveRevealInputs result -> executeReveal -> buildRevealTxn) is mocked away in the component test and has no test. decisions.md places the regression test at the resolveRevealInputs level and keeps useRevealVote.ts unchanged, so this is accepted rather than open.
findings.requirement: sends `justification: "stored text"` to the reveal builder
